Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO. Totally understand the risk of losing momentum.

We can absolutely keep the sandbox accessible. Two immediate options:
- Issue a 7-day temporary voucher (tokens allocated to your org) while procurement clears — we’ll apply this to the same project.
- Keep the current trial active with a soft cap increase for 72 hours while your PO completes.

If you want the voucher, I just need: PO number (or confirmation this draft will be the PO), the procurement contact (email), and the single account/project to attach it to. If legal needs additional vendor paperwork from our side, flag it here and I’ll loop in our compliance team.
